exact_items: - `Tools.md` is now a fully visible three-way SSOT split (`Tools.md` / `Contracts_V0.md` / `storage-plan.md`) for `tool.denied`, still allows `pending-HITL` without a legal persisted tool-approval contract, and still lacks durable event families for unavailable/degraded tool truth.
